en: Conditioned by a state that is neither a root nor has the Path as its object, a state that is a root and has the Path as its object arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither a root nor is rooted in the Path, a state that is a root and is rooted in the Path arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither a root nor has the Path as its dominant factor, a state that is a root and has the Path as its dominant factor arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
